dog.description_text:
Meet Reegina, a majestic, independent queen who is currently looking for her ultimate, most patient subject.
ðŸ‘‘ The Former Super-Mom
Reegina recently graduated from the ultimate elite training program: raising 5 healthy, pristine, and perfectly clean nursing babies. She was an absolute superstar mom! In fact, her foster parent fell so hard for the family that she adopted one of her kittens, and Reegina currently rules the apartment alongside her mini-me.
ðŸˆâ€â¬› The "Spirit Cat" Life
While she loves the cozy apartment life and now confidently roams her domain, Reegina is what we call a "spirit cat"-a beautiful, ethereal presence who prefers to look but not touch. Because humans haven't always been kind to her in the past, she keeps a strict "look with your eyes, not with your hands" policy. If you get a bit too close too fast, she will give you a little hiss, a gentle warning swat (claws safely retracted!), or simply bolt like a furry ninja. Extendable scratch sticks? How about an extendable "no thank you!" She prefers to admire you from a safe, respectful distance.
ðŸ— The Way to Her Heart: Snacks!
While she might seem untouchable, Reegina has one major weakness: food. She is highly food-motivated, which is the secret key to her heart. Her future family can use delicious treats to slowly condition her, helping her realize that human hands bring nothing but rewards, safety, and churu.
ðŸ¡ The Ideal Home
Reegina needs an elite tier of adopter. We are looking for someone who thinks, "I would gladly wait 1 or 2 years for a single head bump." She needs a quiet, slow-paced home with an exceptionally patient human who understands that true trust takes time.
If you have a quiet home, a heart full of patience, and a cupboard full of treats, Reegina might just be the beautiful, independent spirit you've been waiting for.
dog.name: Reegina
